title: Vitest
simpleMetaphor: Blazing fast Vite-native unit test runner to verify functions and components.
technicalExplanation: Next-generation unit testing framework powered by Vite with instant HMR and Jest compatibility.

title: Jest
simpleMetaphor: Classic testing framework for verifying JavaScript functions and component snapshots.
technicalExplanation: Delightful JavaScript testing framework with a focus on simplicity and snapshot testing.

title: Playwright
simpleMetaphor: Automates real browsers to test full user journeys end-to-end.
technicalExplanation: End-to-end testing library for modern web applications across Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit.

title: Cypress
simpleMetaphor: Developer-friendly end-to-end testing with visual time-travel debugging.
technicalExplanation: Front-end testing tool built for the modern web with real-time DOM execution.

title: ESLint
simpleMetaphor: Analyzes your code to highlight bugs, syntax errors, and bad practices as you type.
technicalExplanation: Pluggable static code analysis tool for identifying problematic patterns in JavaScript/TypeScript.

title: Prettier
simpleMetaphor: Automatically formats your code layout and indentation on every save.
technicalExplanation: Opinionated code formatter supporting JavaScript, TypeScript, CSS, HTML, and JSON.
